diagnostic: D1 uncertainty spectrum vs white driver
units: All per-mode powers are E|x_k|^2 of the rfft2 with norm='ortho' of fields in NORMALISED model units (archive / std). A white field with per-pixel variance s^2 has s^2 in every mode, so the white driver is a^2/3 per mode. To convert to archive units multiply by std^2; to key_findings' enstrophy convention (norm='forward', 0.5|w_k|^2) multiply by 0.5*std^2/(H*W).

arrays_format.shell: rfft-grid integer shell index floor(sqrt(kx^2+ky^2)+0.5) [H, W//2+1]
arrays_format.multiplicity: count of each rfft mode in the full FFT grid (1 or 2)
arrays_format.white_level: a^2/3, the per-mode variance of M_1 in the same units
arrays_format.<name>: [C, H, W//2+1] float64 per-mode mean power (pooled over all cases), units above
arrays_format.<name>_per_trajectory: [n_traj, C, H, W//2+1] float32 per-trajectory means (increment/climatology)
arrays_format.<name>_per_case: [cases, C, H, W//2+1] float32 per case (anomaly); case order = trajectory-major, origins inner
arrays_format.anomaly_si<steps>_<noise>_error: [C, H, W//2+1] ensemble-mean error power |ybar - y|^2
arrays_format.use_for_WP1: Sigma_k estimate = anomaly_* (model ensemble) or increment_validation (upper bound); C_k = kappa * Sigma_k / q(1) with q(1) = a^2/3
